name: Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme for Wards of States/UTs Police Personnel Martyred during Terror/Naxal Attacks
provider: Ministry of Home Affairs (Welfare and Rehabilitation Board) under the National Defence Fund

value: State/UT police personnel martyred in terror/naxal attacks
rules.quote: Dependent wards of States/UTs Police Personnel who are martyred during Terror/ Naxal attacks are eligible under this category

value: first professional degree (Engg, Medicine, Dental, Veterinary, BBA, BCA, B.Pharma, B.Sc Nursing/Agri, MBA, MCA)
rules.quote: Pursuing first professional degree programme in the field of Engineering, Medicine, Dental, Veterinary, BBA, BCA, B. Pharma, B.SC (Nursing, Agriculture, etc.), MBA and MCA etc.
Having minimum 60% marks in Minimum Entry Qualification (MEQ) i.e. 10+2/Diploma/Graduation or equivalent in case of new applicant.

rules.value: 500 scholarships (250 boys, 250 girls); no rank restriction
rules.quote: martyred during Terror/ Naxal attacks in equal number to the Boys and Girls (i.e. 250 for boys and 250 for girls)
This scholarship is admissible for only two Children per family
Applicants pursuing courses, such as Diploma courses, not leading to award of a degree or pursuing master degree programme except MBA, MCA subject to first professional course.

amount.text: Rs 3,000 per month for girls (Rs 36,000 p.a.); Rs 2,500 per month for boys (Rs 30,000 p.a.); up to 5 years
amount.quote: Rs. 3000/-per month for girls . To be paid annually after selection. II. Rs. 2500/- per month for boys @ Rs 36,000/-to each girl & Rs 30,000/- to each boy

documents.name: State Government certificate that the police personnel was killed in terror/naxal violence
documents.quote: A certificate issued by the State Govt. concerned indicating that the States/UTs Police personnel was killed in terror/naxal violence is required to be uploaded.

documents.name: Attested MEQ marksheet
documents.quote: Applicants are required to upload duly attested scanned copy of the Mark sheet MEQ i.e. XII/Diploma/Graduation or equivalent is mandatory
